title: Expedition 33 Walkthrough - Full Story Guide
description: Complete walkthrough for Clair Obscur Expedition 33 covering Prologue through Act 3, all main quests, difficulty options, and missable content warnings.

sections.title: Overview & Difficulty Options
sections.content:
Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a turn-based RPG from Sandfall Interactive where you lead a party against The Paintress, a being who erases people from existence each year by painting a number on her canvas. The main story spans 14 primary dungeon locations connected by an overworld map called The Continent.

Difficulty Settings

DifficultyEnemy DamageParry/Dodge WindowsBest For
StoryReducedMore generous timingPlayers focused on narrative
ExpeditionerNormalStandard timingIntended experience
ExpertIncreasedStrict timing requiredPlayers seeking challenge

Difficulty can be changed at any time and does not affect trophies or achievements. The game also includes accessibility options like Auto QTE, though this reduces maximum damage output compared to manual inputs.

Key Tips Before Starting

  • Explore thoroughly — most areas have hidden paths with weapons and Pictos
  • Talk to every NPC at camp between story beats for relationship building
  • Burn stacks from Lune benefit the entire party — apply them early in every fight
  • Save exploration of DANGER zones for when you meet the recommended level

sections.title: Prologue
sections.content:
The Prologue introduces the world of Lumiere and the annual ritual known as the Gommage, where The Paintress erases all people of a certain age. You control Gustave as he prepares for Expedition 33 — the latest attempt to reach and defeat The Paintress.

Key Events

  • Experience the Gommage ceremony and learn about the painting mechanic
  • Basic combat tutorial covering attacks, dodging, and parrying
  • Meet initial party members and establish the expedition's purpose

Side Activities

  • A Uniform for Richard's Son: Optional quest available during the festival
  • Find 3 Festival Tokens: Scattered throughout the Prologue area

Missable Warning

Critical: Obtain the Old Key before progressing past the second section of the Prologue. This key is required for the "Follow the Trail" trophy (collect all Journals). Missing it locks you out permanently in your current playthrough.

Also fight the optional Mime enemy at the far end of the first area — this is required for the "A Peculiar Encounter" trophy and cannot be obtained from any other Mime later in the game.

sections.title: Act 1 (Spring Meadows → Stone Wave Cliffs)
sections.content:
Act 1 focuses on Gustave as he assembles his expedition team and crosses The Continent toward The Paintress. You'll explore six major areas and recruit key party members.

Spring Meadows (Level 3-5)

Your first proper dungeon after the Prologue. Defeat the Spring Meadows Mime and the Eveque boss. Complete Jar's Light optional quest for rewards. The Chromatic Lancelier is an optional boss — come back later if it's too tough for the Professional trophy.

Flying Waters (Level 8)

A waterfall-themed area with multiple paths. Key objectives include defeating the Goblu story boss, completing the Demineur quest (rewards Deminerim weapon for Lune), and defeating the optional Bourgeon (required for a later quest). This area unlocks weapon upgrades, Colour of Lumina, and Tint upgrades.

Ancient Sanctuary (Level 12)

A maze-like dungeon with the Ultimate Sakapatate as its required boss. Find the Catapult Nevron here for Lune's excellent Trebuchim weapon. The Small Bourgeon side area is also accessible.

Gestral Village (Level 15)

A hub area with extensive side content: Karatom quest, Ono-Puncho challenge, Alexsoundro's request, the Hidden Gestral Arena (solo-fight Pictos), Gestral Beach (swimsuits), and the Red Woods fountain. Recruit Sciel here.

Esquie's Nest (Level 17)

After defeating the Esquie's Nest Mime and the Francois boss, you gain the ability to ride Esquie on the overworld (much faster travel). Turn in Lost Gestrals at camp for rewards.

Stone Wave Cliffs (Level 19)

The final Act 1 area. Complete the Hexga quest, defeat Lampmaster and the White-Haired Man. After completion, you unlock swimming — opening previously inaccessible areas. Beat Chromatic Hexga in the Stone Wave Cliffs Cave for bonus loot.

sections.title: Act 2 (Forgotten Battlefield → Monolith)
sections.content:
Act 2 shifts focus to the mysterious Verso, who joins the party and introduces new combat dynamics through his Perfection Rank system.

Forgotten Battlefield (Level 23)

An atmospheric warzone with the Dualliste as the required boss (drops the excellent Dualiso weapon for Verso). Tackle the Chromatic Luster optional boss while exploring — its weapon Lusteson is strong for Sciel.

Monoco's Station (Level 25)

Recruit Monoco the Gestral here. Talk to Grandis Fashionist for cosmetic outfits. The Frozen Hearts area is nearby but extremely high level — return later. Explore the Carousel for items and lore. Defeat Stalact and Monoco as story bosses.

Old Lumiere (Level 28)

Return to a ruined version of the starting city. Renoir is the required boss. The Chromatic Danseuse lurks as an optional fight. Consider visiting the nearby Esoteric Ruins and overworld bosses when appropriately leveled.

Visages (Level 32)

A mask-themed dungeon with four emotional vales (Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear). Each vale contains its own boss — Jovial Moissonneuse, Sorrowful Chapelier, Seething Boucheclier. The Mask Keeper is the required story boss.

Sirene (Level 37)

An underwater-themed dungeon with Tisseur, Glissando, and Sirene as sequential required bosses. Defeating Sirene rewards Tisseron for Sciel. The Chromatic Greatsword Cultist is the notable optional fight here.

The Monolith (Level 43)

Act 2's climax. Multiple bosses including The Paintress (Giant form), Eveque, Gargant, Renoir (second fight), and ultimately The Paintress herself. The Clair Obscur optional boss also awaits for completionists.

sections.title: Act 3 & Postgame
sections.content:
Act 3 centers on Maelle and represents the story's finale. The full world map becomes available for exploration, including all previously locked optional areas.

Lumiere (Final Chapter)

The entire Continent is now open. Before confronting the final boss, consider completing:

  • Optional Bosses: Over 90 optional bosses become accessible including high-level Chromatic variants
  • Endless Tower: A multi-floor gauntlet of increasingly difficult fights with unique rewards
  • Relationship completion: Maximize relationships with all party members for unique scenes and weapons
  • Collectibles cleanup: All areas remain accessible for Journals, Records, Lost Gestrals, and Tints

Postgame

After defeating the final boss, loading your save places you at the last Expedition Flag before the encounter. All areas remain available for exploration and cleanup. You are not locked out of any content.

New Game+

Starting New Game+ keeps your party levels and upgrades but erases your previous save completely. Most trophy-related collectibles reset, meaning you should complete everything in your first playthrough. NG+ is optional and not required for any trophy.

sections.title: Missable Content Warning
sections.content:
Expedition 33 has very few permanently missable items, but the ones that exist are critical for trophy hunters. Here is every missable element:

Prologue Missables

  • Old Key: Must be obtained before leaving the second Prologue section. Required for "Follow the Trail" (all Journals) trophy. Cannot be obtained later.
  • Prologue Mime fight: Required for "A Peculiar Encounter" trophy. Only this specific Mime counts — no other Mime in the game qualifies.

Act 2 Missables

  • Optional Camp Interaction: One specific relationship event for a Record collectible. Only available during a brief window in Act 2. Required for the "Connoisseur" trophy.

Act 3 Missables

  • Maelle Relationship Interaction: A critical conversation with Maelle during Act 3. Missing this locks you out of specific content. Related to the "Maelle" trophy.

Non-Missable Reassurance

Everything else in the game — weapons, Pictos, bosses, side quests, and exploration — can be completed after the story. The game uses 21 rotating autosave slots with no manual saves, so you cannot create safety saves. If worried about missables, follow a collectible guide from the start.

Trophy-Relevant Tip

The "Professional" trophy (beat a boss without taking damage) is easiest against the Chromatic Lancelier in Spring Meadows — but return at a higher level rather than attempting it at Level 5.
